allow.name: actualizar-servidor
args: $standalone='C:\NexoSoft-Servidor\scripts\actualizador-servidor.ps1'; $legacy='C:\NexoSoft\scripts\actualizacion\actualizar-servidor.ps1'; if (Test-Path $standalone) { $a=@('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$standalone,'-ServidorDir','C:\NexoSoft-Servidor\dist-servidor','-NodeDir','C:\NexoSoft-Servidor\node-portable') } elseif (Test-Path $legacy) { $a=@('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$legacy) } else { exit 3 }; $p=Start-Process -FilePath powershell.exe -ArgumentList $a -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru; exit $p.ExitCode

allow.name: excluir-antivirus
args: $pos=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'NexoSoft POS'; $c=@((Join-Path $pos 'excluir-antivirus.ps1'),(Join-Path $pos 'resources\excluir-antivirus.ps1'),'C:\NexoSoft-Servidor\scripts\excluir-antivirus.ps1'); $s=$c | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $s) { exit 3 }; $a=@('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',('"'+$s+'"'),'-CarpetaPos',('"'+$pos+'"')); $p=Start-Process -FilePath powershell.exe -ArgumentList $a -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru; exit $p.ExitCode
